root_cause.text: In `hci_le_create_big_complete_evt`, the loop iterating over BT_BOUND connections accesses `ev->bis_handle[i++]` without first verifying that the index `i` is less than `ev->num_bis`, leading to out-of-bounds reads and, when invalid handles are rejected, an infinite loop because the same connection is repeatedly found.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (ev->num_bis <= i)` before the array access, and the CVE description states: "there is no check that i stays within ev->num_bis before the array access" and "the loop reads beyond the valid bis_handle[] flex array into adjacent heap memory" and "the same connection is then found again...creating an infinite loop".

intent_record.intent_summary: Add missing sanity checks and error cleanup to avoid out-of-bounds and leaked connections in hci_le_create_big_complete_evt
intent_record.what: Added a bounds check for ev->num_bis before accessing ev->bis_handle[i], and added error handling block when hci_conn_set_handle fails, including setting status, calling hci_connect_cfm and hci_conn_del before continuing.
intent_record.how: Prevents out-of-bounds access by verifying ev->num_bis > i, and ensures that if setting the BIS handle fails, the connection is properly removed and the BIG creation is terminated with an error status.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing termination of BIG when creation fails with an unspecified error.
intent_record.what: Modified the condition in hci_le_create_big_complete_evt to also check for ev->status == HCI_ERROR_UNSPECIFIED, and added a comment explaining the intent.
intent_record.how: The BIG will now be terminated not only when the creation succeeded but no BISes are connected, but also when the creation failed with an unspecified error (HCI_ERROR_UNSPECIFIED).
